seo.title: ODDfest 2027 — Helsinki's creative week
seo.description: ODDfest is Helsinki's creative week: a city-wide programme of independently organised events, brought together under one shared umbrella. Bring your event idea for 2027.

whatItIs.headline: Made across Helsinki, by the people taking part.
whatItIs.body: ODDfest is a week of events made across Helsinki by the people taking part in it. Artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies host their own events, exhibitions, performances, gatherings and experiments — and ODD brings them together into one shared programme for the city. Organisers keep ownership and control of what they make; ODD's job is the shared umbrella: identity, communications, visibility and connections across the week.

howItWorks.title: Bring an idea
howItWorks.body: An event, exhibition, performance, workshop, screening, dinner, open studio, club night, conversation — or something we haven't thought of.

howItWorks.title: Register it for ODDfest
howItWorks.body: Tell us what you want to make happen and where you are with the idea. It doesn't need to be finished yet.

howItWorks.title: Make it yours
howItWorks.body: You organise and own your event. ODD connects it to the shared programme, communications and the other people involved.

howItWorks.title: Helsinki experiences it together
howItWorks.body: For one week, independent activity across the city becomes one discoverable creative programme.

register.headline: Have something you want to bring to ODDfest?
register.body: We're now collecting ideas for ODDfest 2027. You don't need to have every detail figured out yet. Tell us what you want to make happen and we'll take it from there.

faq.question: What is ODDfest?
faq.answer: ODDfest is Helsinki's creative week — a city-wide programme of independently organised events taking place across the city under one shared ODDfest umbrella, running in 2027.

faq.question: Who can organise something?
faq.answer: Artists, collectives, venues, organisations, communities and companies — anyone with an event or idea they want to bring to Helsinki's creative week.

faq.question: What kind of events can be part of it?
faq.answer: Exhibitions, performances, screenings, club nights, workshops, talks, open studios, dinners — or anything else that belongs in Helsinki's creative life. If you're not sure it fits, ask us.

faq.question: Who is responsible for producing and paying for my event?
faq.answer: You are. You keep control of your event's production, budget and content — ODDfest doesn't take it over or fund it centrally.

faq.question: What does ODD provide?
faq.answer: A shared programme and identity, visibility and discovery, shared communications, and connections to other organisers, audiences and partners.

faq.question: Does it cost anything to take part?
faq.answer: That's not confirmed yet — participation terms for 2027, including whether there's a fee, are still being finalised.

faq.question: Can events be free or ticketed?
faq.answer: Either. Ticketing, where it exists at all, is set by each individual host — not centrally by ODD.

faq.question: Where can events happen?
faq.answer: Wherever the host is: venues, studios, galleries, offices, streets and unexpected spaces across Helsinki.

faq.question: When is ODDfest 2027?
faq.answer: The exact 2027 dates haven't been confirmed yet. Register your interest and we'll let you know as soon as they're set.

faq.question: How do I submit an idea?
faq.answer: Use the "Register your event idea" link on this page — tell us what you're thinking and where you are with it, and we'll take it from there.

faq.question: How does attending ODDfest work?
faq.answer: Once the 2027 programme is live, each event is listed with its own details — venue, time and whether it's ticketed. There's no single central ODDfest ticket, since the programme is hosted independently across the city.
